description: Run by the renovate repo's workflow (the global config, and default.json for the shared settings). Every update is a PR, nothing automerges: a merge is a deploy.

customManagers.description: Versions with a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment on the line above (lint.yml)
Images in chart values whose repository is the chart's default: `# renovate: image=<name>` above `tag: <tag>@<digest>` (charts without a digest value) or `tag: <tag>` and a `digest:`/`sha:` line

packageRules.description: apiVersions are changed by hand, with the controller upgrade that needs it
The flux manager already finds Envoy Gateway's image (a string in its values)
Charts whose values set image.repository: the regex manager (kube-vip) or update-pins.sh (the chart's appVersion) sets the tag and digest, the flux manager would only change the tag
A chart and lint.yml's CRD schemas move together (update-pins.sh sets the images to the chart's appVersion)

prBodyNotes: Also check the Gateway API version the chart installs and bump `GATEWAY_API_VERSION` and its checksum in lint.yml by hand.

packageRules.description: lint.yml tests Vector's config with the image's version

prBodyNotes: [tools-bin's PR](https://github.com/HiredNoobs/tools-bin/pulls?q=is%3Apr+fluxcd%2Fflux2) bumps the CLI (`FLUX_VERSION` in `context-setup`): merge it with this one.

packageRules.description: Longhorn only upgrades one minor version at a time
prBodyNotes: Read the upgrade notes first: https://longhorn.io/docs/latest/deploy/upgrade/. Longhorn can't be downgraded.

packageRules.description: Vendored manifests: update-pins.sh re-vendors them when the image changes
prBodyNotes: The vendored release manifest was replaced with the new version's: review its diff.

packageRules.description: Unbound's version and the image's build (1.26.2-0), not the -quic variant: Docker versioning only compares tags with the same build, as a compatibility suffix
Checks before and after merging, every PR first, then the component's own (prBodyNotes add up across rules)
prBodyNotes: After merging: `flux get kustomizations -A` all Ready once Flux has applied it, `deployment status <namespace>` for the pods it rolled, and no new KubePodCrashLooping, KubePodNotReady or FluxResourceNotReady.

Before: Grafana Storage → Longhorn shows no degraded or faulted volumes and every node schedulable (`kubectl -n longhorn-system get volumes.longhorn.io,nodes.longhorn.io`), then `deployment longhorn_backup`. After: the same, and each volume's engine moving to the new version (`kubectl -n longhorn-system get volumes.longhorn.io -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,IMAGE:.status.currentImage`).
After: `flux check`, `flux get all -A` Ready, Grafana Flux → Flux Cluster Stats, and Flux's commit status on the next merge in Forgejo.
After: `kubectl get certificates -A` all Ready, Grafana Platform → Cert-manager, CertificateNotReady quiet.
After: `kubectl get externalsecrets -A` all SecretSynced, Grafana Platform → External Secrets Operator, ExternalSecretNotSynced quiet.

Before and after: Grafana Gateway → Envoy Gateway Global and Envoy Global. After: `kubectl get gateway,httproute -A` Programmed and Accepted, the sites load and an Authelia login works, Grafana Services → Blackbox Exporter probes up (ProbeFailed, GatewayBackendErrors quiet).
After: the LoadBalancer Services keep their IPs (`kubectl get svc -A | grep LoadBalancer`), and the Gateway and Pi-hole's DNS answer on them.
After: Grafana Monitoring → Log pipeline: every source still arriving, no errors or drops; LogPipelineErrors, VectorSendFailing, VectorSinkStalled and VectorGeoDataMissing quiet.
After: Grafana Monitoring → VictoriaMetrics, vmagent and vmalert: ingestion steady, targets up (TargetDown quiet), rules evaluating without errors; Watchdog still reaching healthchecks.io.
After: Grafana Monitoring → VictoriaLogs and Log pipeline: ingestion steady, and Gateway → Gateway logs loads.
After: log in through Authelia, open Overview → Homelab overview and Gateway → Gateway logs (the VictoriaLogs plugin); no OOMKilled restarts (`deployment status monitoring`).

Before a minor version: `rabbitmq list_feature_flags` all enabled (else `rabbitmq enable_feature_flag all`). After: Grafana Services → RabbitMQ-Overview with 3 nodes, `rabbitmq diag metadata_store_status`, contentbot still consuming; after a minor version, `rabbitmq enable_feature_flag all` again.
After: Grafana Services → Redis with one master and both replicas in sync (`redis SENTINEL master redis`); RedisNoMaster and RedisReplicaNotSyncing quiet.
After: `deployment status falco` with a pod on every node, Grafana Security → Security overview still showing events, FalcoDroppingEvents and FalcoAlertsLost quiet.
After: a login to a protected app (Grafana) through Authelia, end to end; Grafana Services → Authelia; LldapDirectoryDrift quiet.
After: names resolve from a LAN client, Grafana Services → Blackbox Exporter's DNS probes up (DnsProbeFailed and PiholeMetricsMissing quiet).
After: AlertmanagerNotificationsFailing quiet, and Watchdog still reaching healthchecks.io.
After: Grafana Services → Blackbox Exporter with every probe up.
After: Grafana Hosts → Node Exporter Full and the Kubernetes / Views dashboards fill for every node, Security → Vulnerabilities still lists the images.
After: `kubectl top nodes` works, and `kubectl get csr` has none left Pending (the kubelets' serving certificates).
After: Kubernetes events still arrive in VictoriaLogs (`event.dataset:kubernetes.event`).
After: the LAN's syslog still arrives (Grafana Network fills with the router's lines).
